places.quote: they did not go down to the landing-place which I could discern to be empty, but struck across the marsh in the direction of the Nore.
places.note: Sandbank and anchorage at the mouth of the Thames estuary, not in London.

places.normalized: The Ship (inn), Thames estuary marshes, Kent
places.quote: the sign of the house (the Ship) was creaking and banging about
places.note: Name of the tavern from its sign; exact location unidentified, so this is only a probable marshside inn.
